verdict.rationale: Swell's AI page says that after a one-time install, "your agent picks up the file contract, the CLI and the validate-deploy-verify loop." It also offers a single call that returns the whole store schema. Together these let an external AI agent drive Swell from natural-language prompts through the CLI and API, but there is no evidence of a native natural-language command interface inside the product itself. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language assistant in the dashboard or admin, documentation of which natural-language operations are supported, an MCP or other agent endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration.
